architecture: Generator vocab 8192 dim 128 depth 4 heads 4, fresh, cpu
why_batch_256: Default batch 8 would rarely hold two witness sequences inside the 8527-line train, so witness would get no positive pair. Batch 256 is about 32x fewer steps per epoch, so the epoch count is raised to keep the gradient-step budget near the live boot (8 epochs at batch 8).
